title: scapitis-ftsz-marker: analysis code and derived data for single cgMLST target alleles identifying the linezolid-resistant Staphylococcus capitis L-clone
description:
Analysis code and derived data for a study screening all 1,492 targets of the Staphylococcus capitis cgMLST scheme for alleles that mark the linezolid-resistant L-clone, and testing every candidate marker in an independent collection of 301 genomes deposited later.

The archive contains the screening, distance, marker-recovery and figure scripts, the cgMLST and seven-locus allele calls for all 921 genomes, the derived distance and performance tables, the extracted ftsZ coding sequences, the main and supplementary tables, the three figures, and the input files for the accompanying Microreact view.

Licensing is split: the code (scripts/ and run_all.sh) is released under the MIT License; the data and derived result files (data/ and results/) are released under CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA in the archive.

Allele definitions of the cgMLST and seven-locus schemes are curated and distributed by Ridom within MBioSEQ Ridom Typer and are available to licensed users of the software; they are not redistributed here. Only the allele calls for the genomes analysed in this study are included.

The de novo assemblies of the 485 discovery genomes available only as sequencing reads are deposited separately (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24453130).
